pull_request.title: [S2] Desktop/Mobile GUI and approved native adapters
pull_request.body:
Implements the approved Loop1 Desktop/Mobile GUI and ADR-0009 native/appearance candidate as one batch. Login/registration, Chat, Friends, Settings/Profile, offline history and reconnect observe existing Repository/Send/Sync orchestration; AI and Plugin present their current unavailable capabilities. Windows native transport, secure refresh and presentation adapters retain the application/native responsibility boundary.

Invalid login credentials now show a safe username/password error on both clients, while other canonical 401 responses retain session-expiry cleanup. No public contract, backend, ACK or database-schema change is introduced.

Validation:
- Fresh independent source review carries forward unchanged product/native/build/CI from the earlier full-source candidate and directly checks the two Auth changes, imports, contracts and minimality.
- Android Architect Approval: five new original captures plus 98 precisely bound prior presentations; actual API34 focused PASS73, true Refresh expiry clears the current session pointer and its former credential slot.
- Desktop compilation/auth lifecycle controls and architecture/frozen/53 tests/clean recovery acceptance pass. Actual Android default TLS/hostname negatives, complete original 134-CA rollback and owned-resource cleanup are independently bound.
- Exact-head hosted CI: pending; all 14 full-range classifier outputs select 13 actual required jobs.

Draft / Task review / S2 OPEN. Human postponed only validation blocked by occupied Windows runtime files to S2 Gate. Windows native matrix and same-desktop-account machine CA/default-TLS rollback proof remain pending; CA deletion is Human-reported. CI or branch publication alone does not authorize Task done, Gate PASS, protected integration or main-repository synchronization.

Evidence: `spec/progress/evidence/LOOP1-CLIENT-GUI-001/android-review-resume-20261007/final-review/report.md`; `spec/progress/checkpoints/2026-10-07-loop1-client-gui-001-android-auth-reviewed.md`.
